name: app.sharekite/sharekite
title: Sharekite
description: Publish web pages and files from your agent and share them by link or with the people you name.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the Sharekite account that this connection uses: its email address and its workspaces.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List up to 30 projects, most recently changed first.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create an empty project and reserve its URL. Repeating the call with the same name returns the same project while it is empty.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read the state of one project.

project.description: The project key, such as client-report.

tools.name: upload
tools.description: Create a prepared version of a project. The live publication stays unchanged. Takes file content only: no local paths and no ZIP archives. Send a large site across several calls with complete set to false.

project.description: The project key, such as client-report.

files.description: Use text for text files and base64 for binary files.

mode.description: Required on the completing call if the project has a version. replace makes the sent files the whole site; patch adds or replaces the sent files and keeps the others of the online version.

deletePaths.description: Paths to remove. Only with patch, on the completing call.

entrypoint.description: The file served at the site's root, set on the completing call. Defaults to the root index.html or the only file; patch keeps the current one.

complete.description: Set false to keep the upload open for more files in later calls.

uploadContinuationId.description: From an earlier call with complete false. Continues that upload.

tools.name: get_files
tools.description: Read the files of a version. Without paths, lists the files; with paths, returns their content.

project.description: The project key, such as client-report.

paths.description: Files whose content to return. Request large files one at a time.

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Change which version is online and who can open it. A call changes only the fields it names. With version, puts that version online; without it, changes only access to the live publication and retries failed invitations.

project.description: The project key, such as client-report.

replaceVersion.description: Needed for a rollback: the version that is online now.

access.description: Who can open the project. Without it, access stays as it is.

mode.description: Required for the first publication unless an audience is already set; otherwise only to change it.

password.description: For the password audience: at least 8 characters. Without it, Sharekite generates a password or keeps the existing one. A new password signs out current visitors.

recipients.description: Addresses added to the existing recipients. Restricted only.

notify.description: Default true. Set false to give access without invitation emails.
